title: Affine noetherian descent with a compatible section
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $S$ affine. Assume $f$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and let $\sigma:S\to X$ be a section. There exist noetherian schemes $X_0,S_0$, a locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated $f_0:X_0\to S_0$, a section $\sigma_0:S_0\to X_0$, and maps $a:X\to X_0$, $b:S\to S_0$ forming a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product], with $a\circ\sigma=\sigma_0\circ b$.

source.place: Tag 055P, more-morphisms.tex, lemma-connected-along-section-locally-constructible, first reduction; Tag 01ZA; Tag 01ZM, limits.tex, lemma-descend-finite-presentation

proof.text: Use Scheme.NoetherianApproximation.ofIsAffine to express S as the limit of noetherian schemes with affine transition maps. Descend f to a finite-presentation q:Y→S_i with cartesian comparison a:X→Y.

Restrict the approximation to the over category of i. Descend σ≫a as a morphism over S_i by the morphism clause of 01ZM, in its Mathlib factorization form Scheme.exists_π_app_comp_eq_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation. It gives a later stage S_j and τ:S_j→Y with τ≫q equal to the transition and π_j≫τ=σ≫a.

Set X_0=Y×_{S_i}S_j, f_0=the second projection, σ_0=the lift of τ and the identity. Set a_0 to be the lift of a and f≫π_j. Pullback projection identities prove the section identity and σ≫a_0=π_j≫σ_0; IsPullback.of_right proves the comparison is cartesian. Finite presentation and qcqs are stable under base change. The base stage is noetherian; the existing locally-finite-type noetherian instance and quasi-compactness give IsNoetherian X_0.
